body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2010') -- <Visual News> Case-Mate(www.case-mate.com) presented its wireless iPhone charging system 'Hug' during CES 2010, which consists of Hug case and Hug charging pad together. The Hug portable charging pad transfer power wirelessly through a magnetic field to the iPhone enclosed in the Hug case.
< AVING Las Vegas team is on-site bringing readers the latest product CES2010 from the show floor, covering the press conferences >
